pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, sub-polygonal medium-brown patches with soft, smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Individual regions exhibit high spatial area relative to the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-cream topological graph with variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes predominantly feature three-way intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane, appearing as a soft-textured continuous line.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, distinct, raised nodular feature is visible on the rump near the base of the tail.
